stem: A 1 kg block rests on a rough horizontal surface (μ s = 0.5, μ k = 0.3). It is pulled to the right by a time-varying force F(t) = 1 + t N for 0 ≤ t ≤ 6 s (g = 10 m/s²). Which is correct? (a) The block remains at rest until t = 3 s. (b) The block starts sliding when F(t) = 5 N. (c) While sliding, the frictional force is 5 N. (d) During sliding, applied force and friction act in the same direction.
answer: b The block starts sliding when F(t) = 5 N
